scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend --if-present && npm run test --workspace frontend --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend --if-present && npm run lint --workspace frontend --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend --if-present
scripts.security:check: npm run security:secrets && npm run security:deps && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
